title: AI chip startup unveils faster processor for data centres
description: A young chip company announced a processor it says doubles the speed of AI workloads. The firm plans to start shipments early next year.

title: Chipmaker unveils new AI processor for data centres
description: The company revealed a processor aimed at large data centres. It says the chip cuts energy use for AI training.

title: Scientists find new evidence of water beneath Mars surface
description: Researchers analysed radar data and reported signs of liquid water deep below the Martian surface. The study was published in a physics journal.

title: Climate study links heatwaves to faster glacier melt
description: A new climate research paper found that repeated heatwaves are speeding up glacier melt in the Alps. Authors call for better monitoring.

title: Central bank holds rates as inflation cools
description: The central bank kept its benchmark rate unchanged, citing slower inflation. Markets rose after the announcement.

title: Stock markets rally after strong quarterly earnings
description: Major indexes closed higher after several large companies reported better-than-expected profits.

title: Underdogs win cup final in extra time
description: A late goal in extra time gave the underdog team a surprise cup final victory. The coach praised the squad's discipline.

title: Star player signs record deal with league champions
description: The player agreed a multi-year contract with the reigning champions, the biggest in the league's history.

title: New vaccine shows strong results in late-stage trial
description: Early trial data suggests the vaccine prevents most severe cases. Regulators are reviewing the application.

title: Hospitals report rise in seasonal flu admissions
description: Several hospitals said admissions for seasonal flu have risen sharply this week. Doctors advise early vaccination.

title: Leaders gather for climate talks ahead of summit
description: Government ministers from more than 40 countries met to prepare for the upcoming climate summit. Key talks focus on funding.

title: Storm hits coast, thousands evacuated
description: A powerful storm forced thousands of residents to leave their homes along the eastern coast. Officials opened emergency shelters.

title: Storm hits the coast and thousands are evacuated
description: Thousands of people were evacuated as a storm battered the eastern coastline on Friday.
